name: Vendor registry
description: The procurement vendor registry as a registered MCP tool server (docs/build/S135). The binding is the MCP endpoint; agents reference its tools as vendor-registry.<tool>. Take a tool snapshot after binding it: only pinned tools are offered.

tools.name: vendor_risk_lookup
tools.label: Vendor registry
tools.description: Looks a vendor up by its legal name in the vendor registry. Returns vendorName, registryId, riskScore (0 to 100), riskBand (low, medium or high) and sanctionsHit.

tools.name: vendor_financials
tools.label: Vendor financials
tools.description: Returns the annual revenue in USD and the credit rating of a vendor, looked up by its legal name.
